metadata.description: Async Unix domain socket capsule with lockfree coordination and SCM_RIGHTS support for file descriptor passing (Docker-critical feature)

scm-rights-specification.overview: Socket Control Message (SCM_RIGHTS) for sending/receiving file descriptors over Unix sockets

send-operation.mechanism: 1. Build iovec with empty data 2. Create cmsg_space buffer (CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(RawFd) * fds.len())) 3. Write cmsg_type=SCM_RIGHTS with fd array 4. sendmsg() with MSG_DONTWAIT (non-blocking) 5. Handle EAGAIN with internal retry queue (up to 8 FDs)
send-operation.note: Supports up to 8 simultaneous FDs per message

recv-operation.mechanism: 1. Allocate cmsg_space(CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(RawFd) * 8)) 2. recvmsg() with MSG_DONTWAIT (non-blocking) 3. Parse cmsg_type=SCM_RIGHTS control message 4. Extract RawFd array from cmsg_data 5. Return Vec<RawFd> (owned file descriptors)
recv-operation.note: Returns ownership of received FDs (caller must close)

scm-rights-specification.docker-use-case: Docker daemon uses SCM_RIGHTS to pass: - Container stdio (stdout, stderr) - Device nodes (/dev/null, /dev/random, etc) - Socket pairs for container networking - Volume mounts as file descriptors

public-functions.function:
Connect to Unix socket at given path
Implementation: - Create UnixStream (non-blocking) - Initialize DualAtomicU64 state (connected flag) - Pre-allocate 256-byte capsule - Return self
Errors: - ENOENT: Socket does not exist - ECONNREFUSED: Connection refused - EACCES: Permission denied

function.name: send_fds
function.signature: async fn send_fds(&mut self, fds: &[RawFd]) -> Result<()>

public-functions.function:
Send array of file descriptors via SCM_RIGHTS
Parameters: - fds: Array of RawFd to send (max 8)
Implementation: - Validate FDs are open (fstat check) - Build cmsg_space with SCM_RIGHTS type - sendmsg() with empty iovec (FDs only) - Non-blocking send, retry up to 3× on EAGAIN - Update metrics counter (AtomicU64::fetch_add)
Errors: - EINVAL: Invalid fd count (>8) - EAGAIN: Buffer full, retry - EBADF: Invalid file descriptor - EPIPE: Connection closed

Receive array of file descriptors via SCM_RIGHTS
Implementation: - Allocate cmsg_space buffer - recvmsg() with MSG_DONTWAIT - Parse CMSG control message - Extract RawFd array (variable count: 1-8) - Return Vec<RawFd> (owned)
Errors: - EAGAIN: No data available - EBADF: Connection closed - EINVAL: Invalid control message

function.name: send
function.signature: async fn send(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> Result<usize>

public-functions.function:
Send small message (inline buffer)
Implementation: - Copy data to inline send_buf (max 128 bytes) - send() system call - Return bytes sent

Receive message with incremental parse
Implementation: - Allocate 128-byte read buffer - recv() system call - Return Vec<u8> with message data

safety-assumptions.assume: All state updates via atomics (grep: zero Mutex/RwLock) Verification: Compilation check + grep
All I/O operations non-blocking (MSG_DONTWAIT, O_NONBLOCK) Verification: fcntl(F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) at connect
SCM_RIGHTS operations limited to 8 FDs max Verification: Runtime check in send_fds/recv_fds
CMSG_SPACE(8 * sizeof(RawFd)) is sufficient for all operations Verification: Static assertion + unit test
sendmsg() never blocks (MSG_DONTWAIT enforced) Verification: System call validation + stress test
Received FDs are valid and open Verification: fstat() on recv (optional, logged if invalid)
Only one CMSG_RIGHTS message per recvmsg() Verification: Parsing logic + test
Unix socket path is valid UTF-8 string Verification: CStr conversion check
Running on POSIX-compliant system (Linux, macOS, BSD) Verification: #[cfg(unix)] guards

feature-flags.flag: Enable AsyncUnixSocketCapsule (SCM_RIGHTS support for Docker) Requirements: std only (no tokio required, async/await via local executor)
Optional: Use with async-channels for full async runtime integration

compliance.framework: Q10: T1+T5 (atomic coordination + streaming decode) Q33: #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] verification Q34: No audit trail needed (no compliance data)
100% computational capsule architecture Inline send_buf and fd_buffer for T5 streaming
Benchmark measurements: <1μs latency (TYPICAL tier) Fair baseline: tokio::net::UnixStream (blocks, no FD passing) Honest measurement: 1000+ iterations, 95% CI
20-question integration framework (not required for runtime primitives)

implementation-notes.note: SCM_RIGHTS is POSIX-only feature (#[cfg(unix)] required) Use libc::cmsg_* macros for portable cmsg handling Support both 32-bit and 64-bit RawFd sizes
Docker uses SCM_RIGHTS extensively for: - Container stdio redirection - Device node access - Socket activation (systemd integration) - Volume mount FD passing
Non-blocking I/O MANDATORY (avoid event loop blocking) Use fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) at connect Handle EAGAIN/EWOULDBLOCK with async retry
CMSG buffer size calculation: CMSG_SPACE(n * sizeof(RawFd)) = CMSG_ALIGN(sizeof(struct cmsghdr)) + CMSG_ALIGN(n * sizeof(RawFd)) = 16 + CMSG_ALIGN(n * 8) bytes
